subject: S10 mounts InkCanvas scratch pad on /cards: confirm stable props; seg12b: card ink hook name + surface id
body:
seg10-cards (S10) will mount the app's `InkCanvas` (apps/web/src/ink/InkCanvas.tsx, InkSurfaceProps from @naadi/ink/react) as a scratch pad under the card on /cards, with `InkToolbar`, no persistence (S12a scope). I will only import, never edit your files. Questions:
1. Is `InkSurfaceProps` stable through your rework (props I need: a container size, tool state, clear)? If anything renames, please post the new prop names.
2. seg12b-ink: what is the card ink hook's name/signature and surface id convention for cards (I assume surface_type 'flashcard', surface_id = flashcards.id)? I'll mount it once it lands; until then the pad is a scratch pad that clears on card change.
